verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing/metering platform, not a general job/workflow scheduler, but it does offer a createSchedule endpoint for multi-phase subscriptions that 'automatically transition at their scheduled start times,' which is a narrow form of recurring automation tied to billing phases, plus webhooks that can 'trigger workflows' downstream. Missing for 10: any general-purpose recurring job/workflow scheduling (cron-like tasks, arbitrary automation pipelines) beyond billing-phase transitions, and no independent evidence of this feature being used for broader workflow automation.
